patches.title: Vote For Valheim in the Steam Awards!
patches.content: We hope you would like to do us the honour of nominating us in this year's Steam Awards! You are, as always, free and encouraged to nominate us for whichever categories you want, but we would like to direct some special attention to the Better With Friends category. For what better way to experience Valheim with a trusty friend by your side as you sail to strange new lands, or as you build your new homestead or battle the Forsaken? Once again we want to thank you all for being here with us on our journey to 1.0, and we hope your adventures in the tenth world are going well! Skål! /The Iron Gate team

patches.title: Patch 1.0.30
patches.content: It's time for a patch! This one features a bunch of fixes and improvements, including some long-awaited tweaks to the Forge of Potential. Please let us know what you think, and stay safe out there in the tenth world! Please note: This patch will affect crossplay compatibility, so please make sure that everyone in your group has updated their game before you try to connect! Patch Notes: Forge of Potential: * Forge of Potential will now return substantially more materials when failing * Forge of Potential initial RNG is no longer seeded on character names * Idol droprates are rebalanced to drop more evenly and show up more consistently in the biome after their target gear as intended * Fixed a number of items having the wrong idols for upgrading at the Forge of Potential * Forge of Potential location will now spawn further away from the middle of the map (only affects new worlds) Tweaks: * Made snow that had been removed by e.g. walking on terrain in Deep North regenerate over time * Krigen and Hexen naturally spawned in outdoors Deep North areas no longer follow players forever, will give up after a while * Made it much less likely for Kall Fimbulbringer’s aspects to sometimes accidentally spawn outside of the boss arena * Unlock “A catch worthy of Njord” achievement if a 5* fish is caught as well, not just 4* * Made it easier to exit the Smouldering Tomb * Tweaked snap points on Timberwood Drawbridge * Tweaked snap points on Ashwood Stairs * Added inverted 26 wood wall to the walls category in the build menu * Tweaked particle counts in SnowStorm environment to make it more performant * Music added to Sunken Crypt * Increased music volume for various locations * Updated music credits * Updated recipe for grausten chest; charred skulls instead of charred trophies * Tweaked drop rates of items in various chests * Updated rain damage, rain coverage for various build pieces * Make smoke particles look somewhat better * Made Tankards and Itemstand props in Deep North villages break on their own if not attached to something * Updated localization * Fixed darkwood beam 67 degree name * Lowered the health of some location setpieces (some rocks in Deep North and Meadows,...

patches.title: Patch 1.0.21
patches.content: A long list of tweaks and bug fixes incoming today! It touches on a little bit of everything, and we hope this patch will serve to give you all a smoother experience adventuring in Valheim. Due to some internal restrictions, the patch will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms. Despite this, however, crossplay will still remain functional, so you can keep playing with your friends regardless of what platform you’re on. Patch Notes: Bugs: * Added a fix for being yeeted at high velocity when jumping on top of some enemies * Snow storms in Deep North / Mountains and Ash storms in Ashlands no longer blow inside of your house * Tree stumps in Deep North no longer sway in the wind * Fixed vendor GUI not opening after having watched cinematic in the current session * Fixed a bug where UI fields for names (World and Character) allowed non-name characters (e.g. ‘>’, ‘

patches.title: Patch 1.0.20
patches.content: We've heard a lot of you pointing out that you haven't been getting as many trophies as you should from your kills, and this patch should finally fix that. We hope you're ready to craft those bear rugs! Please Note: There is a small delay with Mac App Store for this patch, which means that crossplay will not work between Mac App Store players and players on other platforms until it has caught up. As soon as the patch is out on that platform, crossplay should work for everyone again. Patch Notes: * Trophy drop chance is now increased by star level of monsters * Pseudo-random drop logic will no longer be reset between player sessions to give a more fair distribution for rare drops * Fixed a possible exploit to Forge of Potential * Reset the cheated flag on all items and build pieces from previous versions, to undo the damage done by a bug in the initial 1.0 release that marked some validly obtained items as cheated. * Fixed bug that caused Cheat Sword and Cheat Sledge to not be considered cheated in specific cases * Fixed dedicated server running at uncapped frame rate if v-sync was enabled in client on the same computer, wasting massive amounts of CPU time * Adjusted attachment points for sheathed weapons * Xbox One/Xbox Series S|X: Fixed settings failing to save between sessions for some users

patches.title: Patch 1.0.17
patches.content: A small bug fixing patch for today, vikings! Due to some internal restrictions, the patch will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms. Despite this, however, crossplay will still remain functional, so you can keep playing with your friends regardless of what platform you’re on. Patch Notes: * Fixed a rare bug that could erase all objects in parts of the world when one large world save chunk file was split into smaller ones. * Fixed invalid item types (most importantly invalid shield of root variant that was available in 1.0.15 on PlayStation®5) causing buggy behaviour. Now invalid styles just reset to the default style and continue functioning normally. * Updated some placeholder text. * Fixed credits being hidden in 1.0.16.

patches.title: Word from the Devs: What a Month!
patches.content: Greetings Vikings! We can’t believe it’s only been a scant few weeks since we released 1.0. We’re so happy to see so many new and returning players alike, and we’re grateful for all the love you’ve shown us so far. Without you, we wouldn’t be here, so thank you! We’re thrilled to say that we have even been nominated in as many as three categories for this year’s Golden Joystick Awards! You can vote for Valheim for Best Multiplayer Game, Best Indie Game and PC Game of the Year, and voting is open until October 23! As you might have noticed, we’ve been putting out a bunch of bug fixing patches over the past weeks, and we will continue to do so, looking over both bugs and balancing tweaks. We thank you for your patience as we iron out all of the wrinkles, and if you do encounter a bug, please make a report and we will take a look as soon as we are able. In the wake of 1.0 we’ve also been dropping a bunch of other announcements on our social channels. In case you have missed one or some of them, we thought we’d sum them up for you in this post. On the merch front, we’ve launched another Kickstarter with Heroic Replicas, where you can get your hands on cool new items like the Valkyrie blanket, or get a new chance to get a shield replica. We also have a new batch of scented candles with Cantrip Candles, with the Meadows, Mistlands and Deep North joining the roster. Finally, we have announced a limited edition hoodie together with Makeship, perfect as the weather is getting colder. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/1bf4aeb53150d8f349fdb72e0c00bb8ac89cdbd6.png We’ve also teased that Valheim is getting its own concert – one in Stockholm and one in Paris – next year. Tickets, as well as more cities, will be available soon, so if you’re interested you should sign up to that mailing list. Another thing on the horizon for next year is that Valheim is entering the world of comic books! We have an absolutely incredible team working on bringing the tenth realm to the page, and we really hope you’ll like what they’re cooking up. On our website you will find some sneak peeks, as well as a link to sign up for more information. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/5c116d4dcd13b5c70487b590aa4e4274...

patches.title: Patch 1.0.16
patches.content: Further tweaks for you today, vikings! This one includes fixes for both terrain modification and for some achievements, so we hope this makes playing smoother for you all! Due to some internal restrictions, the patch will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms. Despite this, however, crossplay will still remain functional, so you can keep playing with your friends regardless of what platform you’re on. Patch Notes: * Fixed a bug that caused terrain modifications to revert in Deep North after unloading the area in some cases. Our apologies that this one went back and forth for a while! You may need to manually fix terrain seams by pickaxing, using the hoe, or walking over snow however. * Fixed a bug that could cause way too many enemies to spawn, especially during raids * Fixed Child of Odin achievement not unlocking correctly * Fixed a case where Comfort is King achievement was not unlocking correctly * Excluded unobtainable Blue Mushroom from The Gourmet achievement * Fixed a bug where smoke from fires could push some enemies in unintended ways * Fixed a bug where snow deposits from trees could cause the terrain to be raised around it * Fixed a bug where certain spawns during the Deep North boss fight could spawn outside the boss area * Fixed a bug where item variants were not applied visually to items on item/armour stands (e.g. shields) * Updated localization * Placeable rocks and boulders no longer take rain damage * Tessellation is now disabled in the “low” graphics preset * Tree logs in Deep North now move more consistently when rolling over snow * Fixed a bug where certain spawns during the Deep North boss fight could render incorrectly when standing in certain places * Fixed an error / potential crash in the online session Player List * Fixed a bug where rolling snowballs far away from the player could result in terrain seams and in some cases, crashes * Switch 2 / PlayStation®5: Fixed a bug where motion controls activation was inconsistent * Switch 2: Fixed a bug where banding artifacts could appear on textures of objects very close to the camera * Mac App Store: Fixed a bug where backups could not be restored via Manage Saves menu

patches.title: Patch 1.0.15
patches.content: We have a small patch today that fixes an issue which has caused some players to have duplicated terrains and decreased performance. If you have been affected by this there is a possibility that you will have some visual seams in your terrain. Simply deform the terrain along these seams, or walk in the snow there to make the seams disappear. Previously, these seams would re-appear after reloading the area, but now they will persist correctly. For those of you who have run into the issue of incorrectly having items marked as cheated: We have a planned fix for this, but as it’s a fix that has to be released simultaneously on all platforms as to not break crossplay, it will come in an upcoming patch. We just want to let you know that you can continue to play normally with these items and they will be fixed soon! Regarding lost levels on items: An important message regarding the previous fix to where items on item stands or armour stands would lose their levels and variants. This was due to the updated save format introduced in 1.0, and sadly this data is lost in the conversion and the issue was not found during our testing of this update. This was fixed in Patch 1.0.12, so any world converted from now on will convert correctly. The good news is that there is a workaround if you are affected by this, either: * Revert your world from the backup which was made when you first loaded the new save format. Note: All world progress & changes you have made in the world will be lost with this method. * Or, make a copy of your backup, and enter into the backuped world, then put all your affected on to your character, and go back to your main world and replace the broken items. If you need help with this please feel free to reach out to us in the support channel on Discord. Patch Notes: * Fixed an issue that could cause terrain duplications which resulted in a loss of performance * Increased drop chance for Deep North Armor moulds by making both Jotun Warrior types drop both medium and heavy armor moulds * Writhan spawn rate and areas increased * Items affected by dev commands will no longer be marked for characters which have enabled the dev bypass command and naming has been...

patches.title: Patch 1.0.14
patches.content: We've got more hotfixes and improvements for you today! This patch touches upon a little bit of everything, from keybindings to music. We hope you're having fun in the tenth world, vikings! Due to some internal restrictions, the patch will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms. Despite this, however, crossplay will still remain functional, so you can keep playing with your friends regardless of what platform you’re on. Patch Notes: Quality of Life: * Added several new keybinding options to the keyboard (Alternate dodge key, hotbar rebinding (on top of 1-8), support for rebinding radial wheel, support for removing keybinds) * Added accessibility setting to be able to toggle blocking * Add toggle to Gameplay settings to skip the intro cinematic on startup * When attacking, the player’s rotation now also snaps towards the intended attack direction when the “attack towards look direction” option is enabled, not just when it’s disabled. * Swapped Motion Sensor and Sheath keybinds on gamepad, returning Sheath to its original keybind. Motion Sensor can now be activated with the alt-key + Sheath button instead. Optimizations: * Improved GPU performance when tessellation is disabled by eliminating unnecessary GPU overhead in this case. * Heightmap shadows are now calculated more accurately and at a lower performance cost. * Optimized particle systems in the main menu to reduce overdraw. * Multiple GPU performance improvements on Switch 2. Bugs & Issues: * PlayerBase effect on some build pieces has been increased to block enemies more * Fixed inaccuracies in stick input pre-processing that made it heavily weighted towards axis-aligned movement and 30% too slow diagonally. * Jotun puffs and Magecaps no longer respawn. * Fix for player characters sometimes mistakenly being marked as temporary cheaters, leading to items dropped by monsters they kill being incorrectly marked as having a cheated origin. * Cheated stackable items no longer stack with regular items, preventing uncheated stacks from being “corrupted” into a cheated state. * Persistent Events devcommand (“pevents”) is now actually behind the devcommands toggle and not available in the console by defa...

patches.title: Hotfix 1.0.10 & 1.0.12
patches.content: Hello vikings! We’ve got some hotfixes ready for you today, to facilitate your adventures in the tenth world. This includes a bunch of new sounds for the Deep North, and that you can now actually repair your endgame heavy armour. Phew! We do also have some Steam specific fixes, which will arrive to all other platforms shortly as well. But not to worry – even though the fixes are Steam specific, crossplay between all platforms is still fully supported. The fixes include a function to let you opt into using achievements even though you have been blocked from doing so because of previous usage of devcommands. We will leave it to your own judgement whether or not to activate this function – Oden will surely know if you use it dishonourably. May your axes stay sharp! We apologise for the delay with the patch for Switch 2, but now all platforms should be compatible for crossplay again! Patch 1.0.10 – All Platforms* The heavy armour in Deep North can now be repaired * Greydwarf Shamans in Deep North now deal appropriate amounts of damage and healing * Punching no longer removes snow * Landing on snow without directly walking now removes the snow * Various sound effects updated for several creatures and the snow in Deep North Patch 1.0.12 – Steam OnlyThe following fixes are fully crossplay compatible and will be extended to all platforms in an upcoming hotfix, which we're pushing out as soon as possible. * Using the Forge of Potential no longer unlocks recipes that should not be unlocked * Items on armour stands and item stands no longer lose their durability & upgrade level IF the world has not yet been loaded in the 1.0 update (We are however looking into a better fix for this so do not remove high level items (fish, weapons, armour, etc) from your item stands without using backups if you have been playing 1.0!) * Fixed a crash that could trigger when players tried to access a zone that wasn’t loaded * Fixed a problem with banlist and whitelist that made them only compatible with new IDs (e.g. V_123456789) even though they should work with old IDs too (e.g. Steam_123456789) * There is now a popup message to make it more clear when you can receive achievements again af...

patches.title: Valheim 1.0 Has Arrived!
patches.content: The time has come to finally venture into the Deep North and Valheim 1.0. We know you’re most likely just itching to jump into the game, so we will not keep you with needless talk! If you have questions about mods and world saves, please do make sure to check out our 1.0 FAQ, otherwise we would like to show you our brand new launch trailer, and invite you read our patch notes below! Patch Notes – Valheim 1.0 Abbreviated Patch Notes: New Content: * New Biome – Deep North * 40+ New weapons * New bombs and ammunition * 4 New armour sets * 2 New capes * 2 New trinkets * New tools * 10+ New creatures * 80+ New buildable pieces * 5 New crafting related build pieces * 30+ New crafting materials * 20+ New food items * New locations * New music * New events * New mechanics * Upgradeable pockets * Achievements Fixes & Improvements: * New graphic setting for draw distance * Menu overhaul for hammer and serving tray * Magica cloth system added * Overhauled descriptions * Rebalanced enemy spawn chance in Ashlands * All hair and beard styles now available from start * Unity engine upgrade * Various fixes and improvements Detailed Patch Notes: New Mechanics: * The snow has fallen thick and deep; best clear it away before you can build! * On frozen seas and pond alike you had better watch your step * The Jotun have begun their invasion of Valheim – set out into the world to halt their advance * Traverse across heights easier with a grappling hook! * Travel to the outer edges of Valheim for a chance to discover alternate versions of earlier biomes * Find mysterious idols scattered throughout the world and bring them to a hidden forge for the possibility of upgrading your items further * Unlock new cinematics as you progress through the game * Visit Haldor to find upgrades to your inventory * Show off with achievements! patches.title: Word from the Devs: Almost there…
patches.content: Greetings vikings! We hope you’re having a wonderful summer! We’re currently gearing up for the 1.0 release in September, fixing some final bugs and getting everything ready for you to experience in just a few weeks. We hope you’re as excited as we are! In the meantime, please do make sure you check out our 1.0 FAQ, which covers many of the questions we have been asked about the release. As always, we recommend that you start a new playthrough to get the best possible Valheim experience, but we also understand that many of you will want to visit the Deep North as soon as you can, and we have tried to answer any questions relating to that! And one last time in case you missed it, the 1.0 announcement trailer: As you know, next week we will be at Gamescom in Cologne, and we really hope to see some of you there. If you’re visiting, make sure to stop by our booth in hall 10 and say hello! And regardless if you’re there or not, make sure to keep an eye out for a brand new trailer that will be premiering during the event. We will be seeing some familiar faces… {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/69290aebe219a4a96e89f7de6496d525f450c5db.jpg And with that, we’ll see you on the other side of 1.0! Build of the Month For many years now, we have been sharing your wonderful and creative buildings under this headline. With the Early Access journey coming to an end, we will also be wrapping up this particular segment – though we will of course still be curious to see what it is you’re building in the game. Keep an eye out on our social channels, because you can be certain that we will be asking you to share what you’ve made! To round off, we will highlight two builds this time. First out is The Bridge by Hi, I'm Klaus. Look at all those creative solutions! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/c9b7cd4ab4d100fc54e0b99601e92bc9cd51df01.png And last, but not least, we want to direct your attention to the Cathedral of the All-Father, built by Ayriv. Since we’ll be going to Cologne it feels only fitting, after all! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/ab5222af43cc594b19f3d0f215bba5012e4ac73f.jpg Sharpen your axes and raise your shields! /The Iron Gate team If you’d like to discuss the content of this post, p...
